macros.name: BOXCONTENT
macros.doc: This macro is short for \usebox{\collectedbox} and will place the collected box into the document.

arg.snippet: collectbox[${1:code at begin}]{${2:code}}[${3:code at end}]{${4:box content}}
collectbox*[${1:code at begin}]{${2:code}}[${3:code at end}]{${4:box content}}

macros.name: collectboxcheckenv
macros.doc: This macro allows macros which use \collectbox to also be used as an environment.

arg.snippet: collectboxto{${1:box register}}[${2:code at begin}]{${3:code}}[${4:code at end}]{${5:box content}}

macros.name: collectedbox
macros.doc: This macro represents the box register defined by \newsavebox which holds the collected box.
